gumroad_listing.title: New FMCSA Carriers — May 2026 — 15,770 Records (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
Every carrier that registered a new USDOT number in the last 30 days (Apr 4–May 3 2026). 15,770 fresh records sourced from the FMCSA Company Census File — the same federal dataset that powers CarrierDetails.com and USTruckingCompanies.com, at a fraction of the price.

**What's included:**
- Legal name, DBA name
- Full physical address (street, city, state, zip, county)
- Phone number (99.8% fill rate)
- Email address (99.9% fill rate, from FMCSA public filings)
- Carrier operation type
- Fleet size (decoded: 1–6, 7–20, 21–100, 101–500, 501+)
- Hazmat indicator
- Date added to FMCSA system
- Business officer name (as filed with FMCSA)
- SAFER source URL for every row

**Quality flags:**
- phone_valid: boolean
- email_suspect: boolean
- country: US / CA / MX

**Top states:** TX 1,817 · CA 1,646 · FL 1,284 · NY 823 · GA 749

**Who buys this:** Trucking insurance agents, factoring companies, ELD vendors, freight dispatchers — anyone who needs to reach newly authorized carriers before the competition.

**Data source:** FMCSA Data Dissemination Program — public federal data, no auth bypass.

pre_ship_requirements: Gumroad listing must disclose: Includes business officer names as filed with FMCSA
